lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: Do I need to come over and, like...bring you something? What do you want?
: a hug!
: Then you will need to get out of the bath first.
: you can hug me in the bath its okay
: unless you dont like chinami when shes wet
: I don’t like when she uses language like that, that’s for sure.
: why not chinami didnt say any bad words
: Chinami will one day understand why some of her word choices are bad.
: papa will one day give chinami a wet bath hug
: Stop it.
: wet wet wet chinami is so very wet!
: I’m turning off my phone now.
: but what if chinami drowns
: you need to keep your phone on so you can call the ambulance for her
: Or, alternatively, you could get out of the bath and text me while you have clothes on.
: if chinami does that will papa come bring her things like candy and a towel to fix how wet she is
: You have plenty of towels in your house, Chinami.
: but chinami is dying and weak and cant reach them so she needs your help
: What’s wrong with you this time?
: probably karma from all the cruelty chinami inflicts on others behind everyones back
: she just returned from robbing a bank and maybe someone was sick there
: who knows!
: I will bring you soup as soon as I can. Please do not rob me.
: chinami makes no promises! bye dry papa! wet chinami loves you!
: Also, please delete all of these messages from your phone. Thanks.
: noooo chinamis precious memories!
: Chinami, you can not send me pictures like this.
: chinami understands
: she tried to hide the rubber ducks but they just kept floating back
: she is sorry she knows you are afraid of them
: That is not why you can’t send me pictures like this, Chinami.
: In fact, just don’t send me pictures at all. My phone is a hot bed for inappropriate content as is.
: chinami wants to see the inappropriate content on papas phone!
: Chinami will never see any such thing and should forget I even said that.
: okay chinami will forget all about the inappropriate content and your fear of rubber ducks
: but she has a request!
: she wants you to send her a picture next so she can set it as her phone wallpaper!
: Set your sister or Yumi as your wallpaper. Or a TV show or something. It’ll be weird if its me.
: no it wont papa is big sis chikas wallpaper and chinami thinks its a good picture its very cute!
: maybe we can take one together next time you come over!
: that would make chinami very happy!
: Fine. But only if you agree to not send me things like this anymore. Understood?
: no!
: Why not?
: because chinami is a free woman with unlimited data!
: shell make a compromise and agree if papa shows her the inappropriate content though
: Not gonna happen.
: then she hopes youre ready for more bath time chinami pictures!
: shes gonna dry off and take another one now!
: And I am going to throw my phone off a bridge.
: You need to stop calling yourself my daughter, Chinami. It’s not healthy.
: nothing about chinami is healthy so shes going to keep doing it anyway
: It really doesn’t make you uncomfortable?
: why would chinami be uncomfortable when she is in the bath
: The bath has nothing to do with it. It’s just that you’ve been calling me that since you met me pretty much.
: if chinami did it wrong its because she doesnt have any experience calling anybody papa since her first one hated her
: I doubt he hated you. He was probably just a bad father. That happens sometimes.
: why?
: Because some people aren’t ready for kids. Raising a child is hard.
: chinami thinks she understands
: big sis chika says doctors bills are expensive so maybe he was just a business man too and needed the capital
: do you think thats where chinami gets her entrepreneurial prowess
: How can you type things like “entrepreneurial prowess” but leave out apostrophes and other punctuations?
: chinami is too busy to be bothered with apostrophes time is money papa shes got bills to pay
: You don’t pay any bills, Chinami.
: you dont know that and for all anybody knows maybe chinami is maxing out her roth ira every year have you ever thought about that
: compound interest papa chinami is going to make this family rich!
: unless she dies :(
: You are not going to die.
: but everyone dies
: Everyone except Chinami. I’ll make sure of it.
: your text can not be completed because chinami is dead we are so very sorry goodbye this number is disconnected now
